title: A SEARCH SOUNDS LIKE HANDS IN A BOX
why: His order of 2026-10-12: add sounds for bandaging, applying armour and the rest. Holding E on a container was silent until a rare item came out, and a common item coming out made no sound at all. Now your hands rummage as the search starts and every half second while it runs, with a light metal knock in a locker, a safe, a cache or a wreck and a softer rummage on a body; a common item that comes out makes its own small sound (a magazine rattle for ammo, a handling sound for the rest), and the rare, elite and gun sounds are kept. Letting go stops it at once. The sounds are the recorded CC0 foley from the v25.20 bank, and your teammates hear them where you stand. Sound only: nothing in the game changes.
now: Searching a container now rummages as you search, and each common item that comes out makes its own small sound.

edits.replacement: if(_lv!=='pick') blip(_lv); else searchFoley(near,'pull',_k);   // v16.xx (usefoleyg): a common item makes its own small sound
